name: USD Coin

expectedCapabilities.justification: A fiat-backed stablecoin must mint and burn to track reserves as users deposit and redeem dollars.
expectedCapabilities.constrainedBy: Reserve attestations and US regulatory supervision

expectedCapabilities.justification: The issuer is legally required to be able to freeze and seize on lawful order, including sanctions enforcement.
The contract is a proxy so the issuer can patch and meet changing compliance obligations.
Circle controls the proxy admin and the owner role, which is how a regulated issuer administers blacklisting, pausing and reserve operations.
expectedCapabilities.constrainedBy: Circle corporate governance and US regulatory supervision

expectedCapabilities.justification: The issuer is legally required to be able to freeze an individual holder on lawful order, including sanctions enforcement. Circle has exercised this.

evidence.detail: symbol() = USDC, decimals() = 6, 2186 bytes of code. Upgradeable via the legacy zeppelinos slot, implementation 0x43506849d7c04f9138d1a2050bbf3a0c054402dd. The EIP-1967 slot reads zero, which is why patterns/evm/proxy-zeppelinos.json exists.
Circle publishes reserve composition and monthly attestations.
owner() returns 0xfcb19e6a322b27c06842a71e8c725399f049ae3a and paused() returns false, confirming a live pause mechanism that is not currently engaged.
isBlacklisted(address) answers eth_call, so the per-address blacklist mechanism is present. Read directly on 2026-09-06 via the pattern that reads it.

caveats: Being listed here does not mean the token cannot lose value or depeg.
It means the named capabilities are structurally expected, not that the issuer is beyond criticism.
An expected capability is still a capability. The issuer can use it.
